preconditions.description: The number of towns n is an integer between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(1 <= x <= n and x != i+1 for i, x in enumerate(a))
preconditions.description: The input array a contains n integers where each a[i] (0-indexed) represents a road from town i+1 to town a[i], and a[i] is never equal to i+1.
